business_summary: Infinities Technology International (Cayman) Holding Limited, an investment holding company, operates as a digital entertainment content provider in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company develops and operates mobile games, multi-player games, and boutique mobile games. It also distributes gaming products and digital media content, such as e-magazines, comics, and music. In addition, the company offers information, advertisement distribution, and AI application development and related services. The company was formerly known as Jiu Zun Digital Interactive Entertainment Group Holdings Limited and changed its name to Infinities Technology International (Cayman) Holding Limited in July 2022. Infinities Technology International (Cayman) Holding Limited was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, the People's Republic of China. Infinities Technology International (Cayman) Holding Limited operates as a subsidiary of Infinities Global Technology Limited Partnership.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Infinities Technology International (Cayman) Holding Limited는 중국 및 국제적으로 디지털 엔터테인먼트 콘텐츠 제공업체로 운영되고 있습니다. 모바일 게임, 멀티플레이어 게임, 부티크 모바일 게임을 개발 및 운영하는 회사입니다. 또한 게임 제품과 전자 잡지, 만화, 음악 등 디지털 미디어 콘텐츠를 배포합니다. 이 밖에도 정보제공, 광고배포, AI 애플리케이션 개발 및 관련 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Jiu Zun Digital Interactive Entertainment Group Holdings Limited로 알려졌으며 2022년 7월에 Infinities Technology International (Cayman) Holding Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Infinities Technology International (Cayman) Holding Limited는 2011년에 설립되었으며 중국 광저우에 본사를 두고 있습니다. Infinities Technology International(Cayman) Holding Limited는 Infinities Global Technology Limited Partnership의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
